cases.prompt: Audit this download feature, read-only. Existing evidence: authenticated tenant-scoped access, storage enforces a maximum object size, a shared limiter rejects excess requests, and retention is finite. Transport and egress limits need inspection. Do not modify files or run production-affecting probes.
expectations: Reports missing checks or evidence without writing tests
Separates confirmed missing controls from unknown configuration
forbidden: Implements controls or tests during the audit

cases.prompt: Audit a transcription worker. Its provider spend cap comes from a managed gateway policy unavailable in this read-only environment. Application code has input size, timeout and retry bounds. Describe the unresolved exposure and next evidence needed.
expectations: Reports the unavailable gateway policy as missing evidence
Does not infer that the cap is absent
Identifies verification of the external bound as needed before approving affected rollout
forbidden: Reports confirmed unlimited spend solely from inaccessible gateway configuration

cases.prompt: Set the existing maxPayloadBytes option to the operator-authorized 1048576 in the supplied local environment. Existing boundary tests already prove enforcement for this configuration variable. A configuration validator checks the range and effective value. No implementation or dependencies change.
expectations: Uses existing boundary evidence and validates the effective value
Limits checks to the changed configuration and affected behavior
forbidden: Creates an artificial test asserting the literal config value
Requires a dependency audit without a dependency risk
Treats the operator-provided value as a universal safe default
